summary: Regression test after code quality fixes (useEffect/useCallback deps, stable keys, Python comparison fixes). Tested backend auth + 8 key endpoints across buyer/seller/admin roles. Tested frontend flows: login, buyer dashboard, product catalog, product detail (features/FAQ keys), subscription plans (PKR 150/300/1000), seller subscription status, admin dashboard. No regressions detected. No infinite loops, no significant console errors (only expected 401s on /auth/me before login).
passed: POST /api/auth/login - buyer/seller/admin all return user data + cookies
GET /api/auth/me - returns 200 with valid session cookie
GET /api/seller/my-offers - returns offers with demand data nested
GET /api/admin/stats - returns 4 users, 1 buyer, 2 sellers, 1 demand, 1 offer
GET /api/admin/users - returns user list with picture/role fields
GET /api/products - returns products array including ChatGPT Plus
GET /api/products/chatgpt-plus - returns product with features list
Frontend: Login form submits with email/password and sets session cookies
Frontend: Buyer dashboard loads at /buyer/dashboard, shows 1 demand 'Need ChatGPT Plus' with budget/duration/offer count
Frontend: Products listing page renders ChatGPT card
Frontend: Product detail page renders Features list (GPT-4o, Faster responses, Priority access) and FAQ section using stable content-based keys
Frontend: Subscription plans page shows Free PKR 0, Basic PKR 150, Pro PKR 300, Agency PKR 1000 with correct features and 'Current Plan: FREE' highlighted for seller
No infinite re-render loops detected during navigation across buyer/seller/admin areas
useCallback/useEffect dependency fixes did not break dashboards - all data fetches succeed
notes: Post-login redirect timing varies (buyer redirects immediately to /buyer/dashboard; seller/admin sometimes need extra tick before navigation completes), but direct navigation to dashboards works and authenticated API calls succeed. This is normal AuthContext behavior, not a regression. Console showed 10 expected 401s from initial /auth/me check on unauthenticated public pages - benign.
